parameters.name: date
parameters.value: ={{ new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'America/Los_Angeles', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date()) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.to, type: 'template', template: { name: 'asignacion_rutas_diaria', language: { code: $json.lang },
    components: [{ type: 'body', parameters: $json.params.map((text) => ({ type: 'text', text })) }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ direction: 'out', phone: $('One message per recipient').item.json.phone, type: 'template', body: 'asignacion_rutas_diaria ' + $('One message per recipient').item.json.params.join(' | '),
    waMessageId: $json.messages?.[0]?.id ?? null, relatedDate: $('One message per recipient').item.json.date }) }}
